version_strings.string: Linux version 2.6.30.9 (root@localhost.localdomain) (gcc version 4.4.5-1.5.5p4 (GCC) ) #68 Mon Nov 28 15:44:03 CST 2016

notes: Image layout: custom 'cr6c' header+bootloader 0x0-0x2818 (MIPS BE, LZMA kernel decompressor), LZMA kernel @0x2818 (uncompressed 4675348 B), squashfs 4.0 lzma @0x161422 (6067203 B, 1423 inodes). binwalk -Me extracted directly; standard unsquashfs sufficient (no vendor squashfs mods).

ZERO literal hits for manifest firmware_version '110b01_all_en_20170301' or variants ('110b01', '1.10.01', '20170301', 'r4156') anywhere in rootfs - nipca pattern: firmware version lives in nvram/mdb config and is rendered at runtime via FirmwareVersion/MainVersion CGI params referenced by web/httpd. Version acceptance anchors: kernel build date 2016-11-28 == filename date 20161128; rootfs file mtimes 2016-11-28; config-cam.dat model 'DCS-935L' + HW 'A1'.
Kernel banner build host is 'root@localhost.localdomain' (no SDK path residue). ZIP folder date 20170301 is the web publish date, not build date - no contradiction with filename 20161128.
config-cam.dat strings '6.0.0' and '1.9.7' are component/schema versions (mydlinkCam config db), not firmware version; mydlink/version 'VERSION=2.1.0-b45' is the mydlink agent component version.

Platform: Realtek (etc/RTS5826.ini ISP fw version=0x58-0b41-a261, etc/Wireless/RTL8192CD.dat wifi driver, config-cam.dat platform 'rtl8881ab'). All 436 rootfs ELFs are MIPS 32-bit MSB (big-endian), MIPS-I, uClibc (/lib/ld-uClibc.so.0), stripped.
Oddity: squashfs superblock carries LE magic 'hsqs' while CPU/ELFs are big-endian MIPS; extraction verified correct via file(1) on all ELFs and readable interpreter strings.

Web stack: web/httpd (82 KB GoAhead-like server, MIPS BE) + web/cgi-bin/*.asp pages + CGI subdirs (greece/{rhea,zeus}, localrecording/setconf.cgi, config, hnap, common). CVE-2026-12174 target /web/cgi-bin/greece/rhea and CVE-2026-13545 target web/cgi-bin/localrecording/setconf.cgi both exist in this rootfs (existence recorded for downstream analysis only).

Two identical squashfs extraction copies appear under extract/ (squashfs-root and squashfs-root-0, same 765 files) because binwalk also found the sqsh signature inside the decompressed kernel image; canonical rootfs copied to scratch/22_DCS-935L/rootfs.
